title: Two-person review for rule changes
why: This team has been burned by a single pair of eyes approving a change to a pricing rule. The catalog asks for an independent review; the team requires a recorded second approver on anything that changes a rule.

addRequirements.title: A rule change carries two approvers
addRequirements.statement: When a change alters a domain rule or a gate, the pull request shall record two approvers, one of whom did not write the change.
addRequirements.failurePath: A one-approver merge on a rule change becomes an incident review with no accountable second signature.
acceptance: Given a pull request that edits a domain rule, when it is merged, then the recorded approvals name two people and neither is the author.

addGates.statement: Rule and gate changes carry two recorded approvers, one of them not the author.

addAcceptance: Given the primary journey, when its rules changed in this release, then the journey test still passes and the change carries two approvers.
